tool.title: WYCZYŚĆ GŁOŚNIK
tool.subtitle: Ustaw głośność na 100%, skieruj głośnik w dół i naciśnij poniżej.
tool.tipNoHeat: Never use hair dryers or rice
tool.safetyRule1: Never insert needles, pins, toothpicks, or cotton buds into speaker grilles.
tool.safetyRule2: Excessive heat from hair dryers softens internal waterproof adhesives and destroys speaker diaphragms.
tool.safetyRule3: Sound vibrations help displace surface liquid droplets from speaker mesh, but cannot repair internal circuit corrosion.

home.metaTitle: Wyczyść Głośnik – Usuń Wodę i Napraw Dźwięk Online
home.metaDesc: Usuń wodę z głośnika telefonu falami dźwiękowymi 165 Hz za darmo.
home.heroH1: Wyczyść Głośnik – Usuń Wodę i Napraw Dźwięk
home.heroSub: Odtwórz fale dźwiękowe 165 Hz, aby usunąć wodę i kurz bez instalacji aplikacji.
home.step1Desc: Ensure your phone or device media volume is set to maximum for maximum diaphragm excursion.
home.step2Desc: Hold your phone with the speaker openings facing down toward a clean microfiber cloth.
home.step3Title: Tap Clean My Speaker & Run Sound Waves
home.step3Desc: Press the button above to play 165 Hz resonant tones that physically oscillate the speaker cone.
home.step4Desc: Run multiple cycles for stubborn moisture, then test your audio clarity using our speaker test tool.
home.whyChooseTitle: Why Use Clean My Speaker to Fix Your Phone Sound?
home.whyChooseDesc: Our online acoustic cleaner is engineered to safely dislodge moisture and fine dust particles using pure sound physics.
home.feature1Desc: Runs directly in Safari, Chrome, Firefox, and Edge with zero downloads or subscriptions.
home.feature2Desc: Engineered to match the natural resonant frequency of miniature mobile speaker diaphragms.
home.feature3Desc: Safe, non-invasive acoustic cleaning that protects internal waterproof seals and speaker mesh.
home.videoTitle: Watch How Clean My Speaker Cleans & Fixes Phone Speakers
home.videoDesc: See how 165 Hz sound waves generate microscopic air vibrations that push water droplets out of speaker grilles.
